description: This file implements WebSocket connection management, including connection metadata handling, connection establishment, message sending, and connection closing within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It defines classes for managing WebSocket connections and their states, handling events such as open, fail, close, and message reception.

classes.name: ConnectionMetaData
classes.description: Manages metadata and state for a WebSocket connection, including handling events like open, fail, close, and message, and providing accessors for connection details.

classes.name: WebSocketEndPoint
classes.description: Manages multiple WebSocket connections, including establishing, closing, and sending messages, as well as handling connection events and maintaining connection metadata.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::ConnectionMetaData
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection metadata with ID, handle, URI, and setting initial status.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::~ConnectionMetaData
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up synchronization primitives.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::onOpen
methods.description: Event handler called when WebSocket connection opens; updates status and server response.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::onFail
methods.description: Event handler called when WebSocket connection fails; updates status, server response, and error reason.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::onClose
methods.description: Event handler called when WebSocket connection closes; updates status and error reason with close code and reason.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::onMessage
methods.description: Event handler called when a message is received; updates last message based on opcode.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::getHandle
methods.description: Returns the connection handle.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the connection identifier.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current connection status.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::getLastMessage
methods.description: Returns the last received message.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::getErrorReason
methods.description: Returns the error reason if any.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::getURL
methods.description: Returns the connection URI.

methods.name: ConnectionMetaData::waitForEvent
methods.description: Blocks until an event occurs on the connection.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::WebSocketEndPoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint with next connection ID.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::~WebSocketEndPoint
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket endpoint, clears logs, starts asio, and runs the thread.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::deinitialize
methods.description: Closes all active connections, stops the endpoint, and joins the thread.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::connect
methods.description: Establishes a new WebSocket connection to the specified URI, optionally waits for connection to open, and returns connection ID or -1 on failure.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::close
methods.description: Closes the connection with the specified ID using the given close code.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::send
methods.description: Sends a message over the specified connection ID and waits for a response, returning success status.

methods.name: WebSocketEndPoint::getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a given connection ID.
